title: CMBComp: A Simple and Accurate Compressed CMB Likelihood for Dark Energy, Curvature, and Massive Neutrinos (Srivastav, Bansal, Huterer)
efc_relevance: Public compressed CMB likelihood capturing the dominant geometric information of SPT-3G D1 + ACT DR6 + Planck PR3 + Planck PR4 lensing, validated across ΛCDM, w0waCDM, νΛCDM, oΛCDM and νw0waCDM. Directly removes the gap theory-efclass-boltzmann-solver bottleneck for late-time-only EFC inference: EFC's L2→L3 fits can now use CMBComp as a drop-in CMB anchor without a full Boltzmann run.
ledger_action: Add to Stage-IV Roadmap as inference-tool import; downgrade gap theory-efclass-boltzmann-solver from blocking to scoped-for-perturbation-sector-only (background+geometric CMB constraints now covered); cross-reference arXiv:2504.20038 (joint CMB-lensing) and arXiv:2503.14738 (DESI DR2); required follow-up: re-fit sealed EFC L2/L3 background predictions with CMBComp + DESI DR2 + Pantheon+ for the next Predictions-Ledger refresh.
